Problem Statement
In a fitness challenge, a participant walks 1 step in round 1, 2 steps in round 2, and so on up to N steps in round N. Calculate the total steps using a while loop.
Description
Read the number of rounds N. Starting from round 1, add the steps for each round to a running total using a while loop. Print the final number of steps.
Input Description
A single integer N (N >= 1).
Output Description
Print the sum of the numbers from 1 to N.
